fullContentHtml:
Bihar Vidhan Parishad Office Attendant Score Card 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Vidhan Parishad has released the score card for the post of Office Attendant. This recruitment was issued for 24 posts. The Phase-II Exam was conduct on 25 May 2026. Online applying process for Bihar Vidhan Parishad Driver, Office Attendant Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 29 September 2025 to 20 October 2025. Candidates who appeared for Phase-II examination can check their Bihar Vidhan Parishad Office Attendant Score Card 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Download Phase-II Admit Card : Click Here
  • Check Phase-II Exam Date Notice : Click Here
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here
  • Check Exam Date Notice : Click Here

How to Check Bihar Vidhan Parishad Office Attendant Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official website link provided below.
  2. Click on the Result / Scorecard link.
  3. Enter your Application Number / Roll Number and Date of Birth.
  4. Submit to view your result on screen.
  5. Download and save the scorecard for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bihar Vidhan Parishad Office Attendant Score Card 2026?

Bihar Vidhan Parishad Office Attendant Score Card 2026 is the official result notification published by the concerned authority. Qualified candidates can download their scorecard using the direct link above.

Where can I find the official link?

The official link is: https://bssc.bihar.gov.in/NoticeBoard.htm

How to check the result?

Visit the official website, click the result link, enter your roll number and date of birth, and download your scorecard.
